children: AITX reported new RAD orders for RIO 360, RIO Mini, ROSA and SARA licenses that expand site deployments and may add recurring monthly revenue.
RAD received orders for two RIO 360 units, one RIO Mini, one ROSA and four SARA licenses from existing customers and channel partners.
Orders expand RAD deployments across additional sites and solutions, positioning the company to add recurring monthly revenue as units are deployed.
RIO Mini order targeted Alaska deployment, citing suitability for remote, severe-weather environments and solar-powered operation.
Company notes orders are subject to customary conditions and may be delayed, modified or canceled and are not material to results individually or in aggregate.
